nodes.name: Melting and Homogenization
nodes.procedure: The equiatomic CoCrFeNi HEA was produced by melting high-purity Co, Cr, Fe and Ni elements in an induction suspension furnace at a temperature of 1700 °C with argon gas. Following this, the molten mixture was cooled inside the furnace for 30 minutes. The aforementioned procedure needs to be repeated four times to ensure the preparation of a chemically homogeneous CoCrFeNi HEA. Then the ingot was performed a homogenization treatment at 1200 °C for 6 h in high purity argon atmosphere.
